node.title: Re^3: Can GTK3 be driven externally?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Disclaimer: This is still just from quick Googling, I actually haven't done this myself, but I hope these pointers help. It looks to me like you would set up a [https://developer.gnome.org/gio/stable/GSocketService.html|GSocketService] which has an incoming event, get the [https://developer.gnome.org/gio/stable/GSocketConnection.html|GSocketConnection]'s [https://developer.gnome.org/gio/stable/GSocket.html|GSocket] file descriptor, and then register that with a [https://developer.gnome.org/glib/stable/glib-IO-Channels.html|GIOChannel] via g_io_add_watch. It also appears that one can write a handler for the client in a blocking manner in a separate thread via [https://developer.gnome.org/gio/stable/GThreadedSocketService.html|GThreadedSocketService].
